forms.ex: Meine Mutter arbeitet bei einer Bank.
forms.exEn: My mother works for a bank.

forms.en: work; job
forms.why: The stem on its own: work as a thing.
forms.note: die Arbeit: feminine, an exception to the bare-stem rule (the noun is older than the verb).
forms.ex: Ich fahre jeden Morgen mit dem Rad zur Arbeit.
forms.exEn: I cycle to work every morning.

forms.clue: to be part of the team on (a project); to take part (in class)
forms.why: mit = with: you work on something together with others.

forms.clue: the staff member, a colleague at work

forms.en: collaboration; participation (in class)
forms.clue: the participation (in class, in a project)
forms.note: die Mitarbeit: feminine like die Arbeit.
forms.ex: Seine Mitarbeit im Unterricht ist sehr gut.
forms.exEn: His participation in class is very good.

forms.clue: to edit (a photo); to deal with (a case)
forms.why: be- makes arbeiten take an object: you work on a thing (a text, a case).

forms.clue: the editing; the handling (of a case)

forms.en: clerk (in an office); caseworker
forms.clue: the clerk who handles your case
forms.why: Sache = matter, case + Bearbeiter = the one who works on it.
forms.ex: Der Sachbearbeiter hat mir alle Formulare erklärt.
forms.exEn: The clerk explained all the forms to me.

forms.en: process (food, data); make into; come to terms with (an experience)
forms.why: ver- = change: you work on something until it becomes something else.
forms.ex: In dieser Fabrik wird Milch zu Käse verarbeitet.
forms.exEn: In this factory, milk is made into cheese.

forms.en: processing
forms.ex: Die Verarbeitung der Daten dauert ein paar Minuten.
forms.exEn: Processing the data takes a few minutes.

forms.en: work out (in detail); draw up (a plan)
forms.clue: to work out in detail (a plan)
forms.why: aus = out, to the end: you work a plan out until every detail is done.
forms.ex: Wir arbeiten gerade ein neues Konzept aus.
forms.exEn: We're working out a new concept right now.

forms.en: working out, drafting (of a plan); written paper
forms.ex: Die Ausarbeitung des Plans hat drei Monate gedauert.
forms.exEn: Drawing up the plan took three months.

forms.en: come to terms with (the past); catch up on (work); do up (furniture)
forms.clue: to come to terms with (a country's past, its history)
forms.why: auf = up, to the end (as in aufessen): you work through all of it, a backlog or the past.
forms.ex: Das Land muss seine Geschichte aufarbeiten.
forms.exEn: The country must come to terms with its history.

forms.en: coming to terms (with the past); reappraisal
forms.clue: the coming to terms (with a country's past)
forms.ex: Die Aufarbeitung der Vergangenheit ist noch nicht abgeschlossen.
forms.exEn: Coming to terms with the past is not finished yet.

forms.en: sich einarbeiten: settle in (to a new job), get to grips with (a topic); einarbeiten: train (new staff); work in (an ingredient)
forms.clue: to settle into (a new job, sich)
forms.why: ein = into: you work your way into a new task.
forms.ex: Ich muss mich erst in das neue Programm einarbeiten.
forms.exEn: First I have to get to grips with the new program.

forms.en: induction, training (for a new job)
forms.clue: the induction (training in a new job)
forms.ex: Die Einarbeitung neuer Mitarbeiter dauert zwei Wochen.
forms.exEn: Training new staff takes two weeks.

forms.en: work together, cooperate
forms.ex: Wir arbeiten seit Jahren gut zusammen.
forms.exEn: We have worked well together for years.

forms.en: cooperation; collaboration
forms.note: die Zusammenarbeit: feminine like die Arbeit.
forms.ex: Vielen Dank für die gute Zusammenarbeit!
forms.exEn: Thank you for the great cooperation!

forms.en: revise, rework (a text); sich überarbeiten: overwork
forms.why: über = over: you go over a text again.
forms.ex: Ich muss meine Bewerbung noch einmal überarbeiten.
forms.exEn: I have to revise my application once more.

forms.en: revision (of a text); overwork, exhaustion (from working too much)
forms.ex: Der Text braucht noch eine gründliche Überarbeitung.
forms.exEn: The text still needs a thorough revision.

forms.en: work out, develop (a solution); earn (by working)
forms.clue: to earn by hard work (sich etwas: a reputation)
forms.why: er- = reach a result: you work until you have it.
forms.ex: Sie hat sich ihren guten Ruf hart erarbeitet.
forms.exEn: She worked hard to earn her good reputation.

forms.en: work through (a list); work off (a debt)
forms.clue: to work through (a to-do list) item by item
forms.why: ab = off: you work tasks off a list one by one.
forms.ex: Heute arbeite ich alle offenen E-Mails ab.
forms.exEn: Today I'm working through all my open emails.

forms.en: work without a break; work through (a book)
forms.why: durch = through: you work through the night, or through a book.
forms.ex: Wir haben die ganze Nacht durchgearbeitet.
forms.exEn: We worked right through the night.

forms.en: keep working, carry on working
forms.why: weiter = on, further: you go on working.
forms.ex: Nach der Pause arbeiten wir weiter.
forms.exEn: After the break we'll carry on working.

forms.en: unemployed
forms.ex: Mein Onkel ist seit Mai arbeitslos.
forms.exEn: My uncle has been unemployed since May.

forms.en: unemployment
forms.ex: Die Arbeitslosigkeit ist im letzten Jahr gesunken.
forms.exEn: Unemployment fell last year.

forms.en: workplace; job (a post)
forms.why: Arbeit + Platz = place: the place where you work.
forms.ex: Viele Menschen haben Angst um ihren Arbeitsplatz.
forms.exEn: Many people are afraid of losing their jobs.

forms.en: development, working out (of a concept, a solution)
forms.clue: the development (of a concept, of teaching material)
forms.ex: Die Erarbeitung des Konzepts dauerte Monate.
forms.exEn: Working out the concept took months.
